chapter: Edgar Blanchard, Danny White and spot jobbing
title: Spot jobbing, the Custom House job and playing today
summary: He played with Placid Adams and Teddy Riley at Storyville, held government clerical jobs ending at the Custom House, retired in 1992, and now plays five nights a week and studies with Roger Dickerson.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work
